shadps4.releaseTitle: shadps4 v0.21.0 - codename Until Mavethee Dawn
shadps4.bodyNotes:
Another week another release . There are ton of changes , so why not ? 

## Core
* Properly check where an input came from for digital->analog input smoothing
* cpu_patches: Work around Rosetta 2 mistranslating negated scalar compares 
* file_sys: Report stable file identities in stat and fstat 
* Allow file type identification for '/addcont' path
* emulator: stop clearing temporary data on boot 
* Add PT_SCE_MODULE_PARAM case
* cpu_patches: Fix JIT patching at addresses outside any module
* core: Fix MemoryManager::Free unmapping past the released rang
* file_sys: don't abort when a guest path goes through a regular file
* use VMA pointers instead of copies in TryWriteBacking 
* cpu_patches: Workaround Rosetta 2 crash on VMASKMOVPS/PD
* Handle ELF metadata and toolchain comments program headers
* common: reuse one high-resolution waitable timer per thread in AccurateSleep
* Don't abort when optional ELF metadata segments can't be read
* cpu_patches: Fix register clobbering in Rosetta 2 VMASKMOV workaround 
* renderdoc: Add library name for macOS
* renderdoc: Add alternate path for macOS 
* lru_cache: Fix early stop in ForEachItemBelow 
* Avoid deadlock when Shutdown is re-entered on the same thread
* Check if elf info is initialized when shutting down

## Libraries
* kernel: Implement I/O event queue APIs with Core::Net integration
* kernel: fail rmdir on non-empty directories with ENOTEMPTY
* app_content: Implement sceAppContentTemporaryDataMount
* kernel: Try lock without wait in timed mutex if deadline has passed
* usbd: Implement libSceUsbStorage HLE for virtual USB media access 
* http: allowing headers with surrounding whitespace
* kernel, rtc: Fix timezone and DST calculation
* music: Implement libSceMusicPlayerService HLE 
* videodec2: Drain pending frames and wrap in RAII 
* usbstorage: Correct OrbisUsbStorageDeviceInfo layout and population
* app_content: Implement sceAppContentAddcontUnmount
* app_content: Implement TemporaryData mount and unmount 
* np_auth rewrite 
* Ajm: Auto-detect and safely parse RIFF headers for ATRAC9 
* libSceVoice: stub a disconnected microphone to fix BO2 and BO3 hangs
* net: report recv_queue_length in sceNetGetSockInfo 
* kernel: Register missing filesystem symbols and fix /dev/null device
* kernel: return ENOENT from mkdir when the parent does not exist
* kernel: return EBADF when writing to a file opened read-only
* kernel: return EINVAL from ftruncate for bad lengths and read-only fds
* kernel: return ENOENT from unlink when the file does not exist
* pad: Implement scePadReadExt and scePadReadStateExt 
* gnmdriver: Fix remapped compute queues starting at a stale ring offset 
* app_content: Load additional content from linked services (SERVICE_ID_ADDCONT_ADD_n) 
* app_content: Populate add-on entitlement keys
* app_content: Fix entitlement keys and service labels 
* playgo: Fix language mask UB and default install speed 
* kernel: Fix self-rename deletion and host path tracking in posix_rename 
* music: Implement sceMusicPlayerServiceSetUsbStorageDeviceInfo
* kernel: Implement posix_flock and sceKernelFlock 
* audio3d: Fix swapped attribute ids 
* audio3d: Fix swapped attribute ids (OpenAL) 
* kernel: Improve Neo mode handling and implement missing APIs 
* kernel: return ENOENT from open(O_CREAT) when the parent does not exist
* videodec: libSceVdecCore HLE and VideoCore server interface callbacks
* np_trophy: Fix platinum trophy never unlocking 
* threads: fix stack base value in windows
* share_play: Implement sceSharePlayGetCurrentConnectionInfoA
* net: answer PS4 device discovery on UDP 987 
* np_score : fixed a few inaccurancy returns and data transfers 
* kernel: Fix filesystem validation and posix_select
* pad: report the DualShock 4 touchpad height (942) instead of 950 
* kernel: return ENOTDIR from mkdir when the parent is a file
* save_data: deliver backup completion callbacks
* fiber: Relocate fiber stacks away from GPU tracked heap on Windows 
* np_score : improved score data transfer, comparable dates and improved friends ranking 

## Video Core
* Garbage Collector part 2
* vk_runtime: Copy every mip level in CopyImageWithBuffer
* Support stencil-only depth targets and decouple stencil sizing
* Fix CE/DE counter synchronization in PM4 packets 
* texture_cache: keep subresource data when its parent image is first created
* texture_cache: don't copy stale CPU-dirty image contents in ExpandImage
* Fix global CE task scheduling 
* texture_cache: Drop GPU-modified images whose untracked edges the guest overwrote
* video_core: Handle PM4 IT_GET_LOD_STATS packet 
* video_core: reset hash on image refresh
* video_core: Fix Ubscaled number format name 
* vk_instance: Support RenderDoc on drivers without capture replay
* liverpool: Follow chained indirect buffers without returning 
* liverpool: Advance past a packet by the size read before running it
* video_core: Compare subresource extents per dimension
* vk_rasterizer: Bound the render area of passes without attachments by the scissors
* video_core: Handle PM4 Type 2 and Rewind packets in Constant Engine
* video_core: Implement PM4 streamout buffer updates

## Shader Recompiler 
* Emit undefined 64-bit integers
* Preserve CFG fallthrough edges 
* Stabilize phi deduplication order 
* Account for singleton dimensions in LDS barrier analysis 
* Exclude GetUserData from Phi folding 
* Accept S_SLEEP as a scheduling hint 
* Handle buffer cache invalidation instructions
* Add fast_shader_math setting to relax float rules
* info.has_derivatives.Assign now also checks for MimgModifier::CoarseDerivative
* Handle HW_ID.SE_ID reads 
* Support GsOp::EmitCut in S_SENDMSG

kytyps5-demon-souls-framegen.releaseTitle: KytyPS5 Demon's Souls Frame Generation v1.3
kytyps5-demon-souls-framegen.bodyNotes:
**What's new in v1.3:** based on the new upstream KytyPS5 **v20261014** by chenxiao07, with all of this build's improvements kept.

- ⭐ **New launcher layout:** the settings are in tabs (Display, Graphics, Performance, System) under the game folder; the window remembers the last tab.
- ⭐ **Shrine of Storms freeze work (known issue #1):** large textures now upload in 64 MB pieces and the partial path no longer re-uploads the whole 1.8 GB pool; this build also turns on upstream's layer-range textures, so the pool's views become small textures of the layers they read (upstream issue #9). Not confirmed at the spot yet: known issue #1 stays open until a session shows it.
- **About 2 GB less RAM** after a save loads, and no more memory growth when travelling between worlds.
- **HDR and VSync options** (Display tab, off by default). With Frame Generation, a G-SYNC display is the better choice than VSync.
- **Fixes from upstream:** a crash when travelling to the Tower of Latria by archstone, a 1.05 crash in Boletaria 1-1, very large textures on 8 GB GPUs, game folders with very long paths.
- **More precompile hints:** shaders from tours of every map, so more first visits are smooth after precompiling.
- **Your shader cache is kept:** upstream now caps the driver shader cache at 1/64 of RAM; this build allows 1/16 (2 GB with 32 GB RAM), so a typical 1.2 GB cache is not thrown away at every launch.

Everything from v1.2 stays: DLSS Frame Generation (**requires an NVIDIA RTX 40 or 50 series card**), render resolution upscaling (the game's own upscaler, not DLSS/FSR), ultrawide for any ultrawide screen, the voices fix.

**Updating from v1.2:** extract the new zip over your old folder (your saves, launcher settings and shader caches stay; the frame generation camera list is replaced by the one in the zip). Your precompiled shaders stay valid; run "Precompile shaders" again if you want the new map-tour shaders too.

**Downloads:** `KytyPS5-DemonsSouls-FrameGen.zip` is the build. `KytyPS5-DemonsSouls-FrameGen-source.zip` is its complete source (KytyPS5 is GPL 2.0; third-party licenses in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

No game files included. Unofficial build, not affiliated with Sony, NVIDIA or the KytyPS5 developers.

kytyps5-jetsku.bodyNotes:
int21 is int20 plus faster draw validation, fixes for GPU device losses and a silent exit, the latest upstream KytyPS5 changes, ports from chenxiao07's fork and a new profile-guided optimisation profile; the older notes are in docs/release-notes-history.md. The first launch rebuilds the shader and program caches once (the pipeline key changed), so the first minutes can stutter.

- **Faster:** the command processor skips the full validity check of a prepared draw when the GPU has never touched the memory it reads (`KYTY_CLEAN_UNTOUCHED=1`, on in the preset; exact, verified over tens of millions of draws), plus a new profile-guided optimisation profile. Measured with the play folder's three game patches on (non-tiled renderer, GI off, fixed 1080p): pirate island about 58 fps against about 53 in int20, and Sky Garden at its 60 fps pacing cap where int20 ran about 54. Without game patches Sky Garden gained about 1.4% over the last test build.
- **Fixed (device loss):** a small upload's copy from guest memory could run after later writes the command processor or the game made to the same memory, so earlier draws read future data and the GPU could hang. Writes now wait for or take over the queued copies (`KYTY_UPLOAD_DMA_WRITE_DRAIN=1`, on in the preset; `=labels` is a stricter mode for anyone who still sees losses). Also fixed: the texture cache could miss guest writes on pages whose protection was still pending, and draws could keep using a buffer that a later merge had retired (`KYTY_REBIND_AFTER_JOIN=1`).
- **Fixed (silent exit):** on Windows set to force Control Flow Guard on every program, Astro Bot closed without a message (ntdll 0xC0000409) right after shader loading (`KYTY_GUEST_TEB_STACK_RANGE=1`, on in the preset; issue #66).
- **Fixed:** exits on colour targets with an invalid format and on a stencil plane shared with another render target (`KYTY_STENCIL_TARGETS_APART=1`), guest file writes from GPU-protected pages that were silently cut short, and pad presses lost during frame hitches (`KYTY_PAD_STATE_COALESCE=1`).
- **Crash reports:** `KYTY_DEVICE_FAULT_EXT=1` is on in the preset and now writes a complete `_device_fault.nv-gpudmp` file next to `_kyty.txt` when the GPU is lost. Please attach it to device-loss reports.
- **Correction to int20:** int20's notes said the Astro Bot "too many objects/batches" crash was fixed; it was only rarer. The cause was that the game's draw threads overflow their command buffers when they fall a frame behind, mostly on CPUs with fewer cores. int21 doubles those buffers for Astro Bot 01.018 (`KYTY_ASTRO_CB_SCALE=2`) and spreads the game's threads over both CCDs on X3D CPUs (`KYTY_VCACHE_GUEST=all`): 0 crashes in about 20 boots of speedrun_inflator, the level that crashed on every boot before. Players with 8-core CPUs: a report from speedrun_inflator would help.
- **Upstream KytyPS5:** about 150 upstream changes, among them user clip planes, f16 interpolation, alpha-to-mask (`KYTY_ALPHA_TO_MASK`), start on GTX 10xx/RDNA1 cards without fragment-shader barycentrics, a keyboard player option, a performance overlay and fixes for other games behind switches that are off by default. Details are in the commit history.
- **Thanks:** chenxiao07 for the fork changes ported here (colour-target and stencil fixes, the Control Flow Guard fix, pad state, file writes, APR file reads and more), and the upstream KytyPS5 contributors.
- **Known issues:** rare GPU device losses can still happen, seen in sponge_dirty_bath without game patches. Please report them with `_kyty.txt` and `_device_fault.nv-gpudmp`; workaround: `KYTY_UPLOAD_DMA_WRITE_DRAIN=labels` or `KYTY_DEFER_PROTECTS=0` in `u59-preset.json` (about 3% slower).
- **Upgrading:** extract into a new folder, or replace `u59-preset.json` too; an old preset leaves the new fixes off.

sharpemu-macos.bodyNotes:
# SharpEmu for macOS v0.0.7-pulse

Upstream SharpEmu dropped macOS (sharpemu#1123), and this repository is now the macOS build of the PS5 emulator. Since v0.0.6 the whole emulator has been ported to macOS on Apple silicon. That covers host memory, CPU execution, the kernel and HLE libraries, the shader compiler and the GPU backend. The fork adds 237k lines of source and 168k lines of tests on top of upstream. Upstream SharpEmu 0.0.7-pulse is merged in.

## Platform

- **Native macOS host** (`src/platforms/macos`, ~10k lines): guest memory, windowing, input and display. Per-OS host packages and SDL/Skia adapters.
- **CPU:** the x86-64 guest code runs directly under Rosetta 2, and imports go through a native import path. AGC packet builders and other hot HLE entry points are answered by native stubs inside the guest.
- **Kernel and HLE:** reworked kernel memory, files, sync and event queues, and the host seam and guest memory model.
  - Fibers lock per stripe instead of through one global gate.
  - The thread-local storage lookup `__tls_get_addr` is cached per thread.
  - User-level-thread (ULT) wakeups are targeted to the waiters that changed.
  - Pthread mutexes spin while the owner runs.
  - Short sleeps nap on an escalating schedule.
- **macOS 27:** the OS reserves VA ranges that PS5 titles map. The loader relocates the affected arena bases, including GTA V's RAGE arena and Ghost of Tsushima's batch maps, and maps virtual views into the GPU carveout.
- **Spin-nap patcher:** guest pause/spin loops are patched to sleep. Demon's Souls' idle job workers nap instead of spinning.
- **Display:** the guest render resolution follows the chosen output. There are patches for Unity (boot.config), Unreal, KEX, GTA V, small engines compiled for 3840×2160, and Demon's Souls (its Bluepoint resolution adapter).

## GPU: Metal V2

- **Metal-only renderer** (`SharpEmu.Gpu.Metal`, ~70k lines). There is no Vulkan or MoltenVK layer, and the earlier Metal V1 backend is removed.
- **Command processing** runs on its own thread by default.
  - Program resolution and prefetch run on a separate thread, with pipeline look-ahead across the submissions queued behind it.
  - Encoders are ordered by one fence instead of a barrier after each.
- **Resource materialization** is native and cached. Bindless tables are memoised and kept resident. Repeated lookups skip searches that found nothing last time.
- **Image cache:**
  - Single-copy retile.
  - Write-back of GPU-written images before guest stores.
  - Alias transitions fused, with dead contents discarded.
  - Memoryless stand-ins for colour targets that are only read or stored.
  - Depth/stencil reached on the device instead of through guest memory.
- **Occlusion queries** are counted on the device.
- **Tessellation** uses the hull kernel plus Metal's tessellator, including Ghost of Tsushima's quad-patch instanced grass.
- **Multisampling:** multisampled depth goes through a one-sample proxy plus resolve. A GPU-written HTILE is no longer loaded as a clear (UE5 Nanite).
- **Pipeline cache:**
  - Shaders compile into Metal binary archives, bounded by use and shared across builds.
  - Shader prewarm stores compute pipelines.
  - Guest stores are served while a draw waits for its shader compiles.
- **GPU worker:** no per-draw or per-dispatch allocations, fewer guest re-reads, less lock traffic. Bench tooling is in-tree.

## Shader compiler: gfx10 → MSL

- **Translator** (`SharpEmu.ShaderCompiler.Metal`, ~25k lines) emits Metal Shading Language directly, at gfx10 ISA parity.
- **wave64** runs as two Apple simdgroups. Multi-wave compute groups are bridged across simdgroups and meet at threadgroup barriers. Upper-lane reads and LDS atomics are ordered across the halves.
- **NGG and mesh:** amplified NGG subgroups run as whole mesh workgroups of real wave64 waves.
- **Ray tracing:** BVH nodes are read 16 bytes at a time, with half-precision boxes widened in hardware.
- **Descriptors:** records chosen at run time, branch-chosen V#s, indirect image tables of up to 256 descriptors, and stores through V#s loaded from record tables are all planned and bound.
- **Fixes:** SDWA destination select, `s_cmpk_*`, GDS M0 addressing, FORCE_DEGAMMA samplers, min/max filter samplers, compare samples of mipmapped images, and GLC store write-through.

## Split GPU process

- The GPU backend runs in a separate **native arm64 process**, now the default where it can run.
  - It maps the guest's backing memory and replicates the guest's views.
  - The two processes talk over a shared-memory transport (protocol 2).
- Page-protection tracking is per 4 KiB page. A posted call wakes a single server thread.
- `build-app.sh` bundles the arm64 GPU host in `Contents/MacOS/gpuhost`.

## App

- The launcher is a native arm64 Avalonia app and is the bundle's main executable. Game windows and Dock tiles are named after the game.
- Launcher settings are global, and game settings are per game, with automatic migration. GUI and CLI share one launch configuration.
- All logs, traces and dumps go under one logs folder. Caches are kept outside the signed bundle.

fallbackRelease.bodyNotes:
# SharpEmu for macOS v0.0.7-pulse

Upstream SharpEmu dropped macOS (sharpemu#1123), and this repository is now the macOS build of the PS5 emulator. Since v0.0.6 the whole emulator has been ported to macOS on Apple silicon. That covers host memory, CPU execution, the kernel and HLE libraries, the shader compiler and the GPU backend. The fork adds 237k lines of source and 168k lines of tests on top of upstream. Upstream SharpEmu 0.0.7-pulse is merged in.

## Platform

- **Native macOS host** (`src/platforms/macos`, ~10k lines): guest memory, windowing, input and display. Per-OS host packages and SDL/Skia adapters.
- **CPU:** the x86-64 guest code runs directly under Rosetta 2, and imports go through a native import path. AGC packet builders and other hot HLE entry points are answered by native stubs inside the guest.
- **Kernel and HLE:** reworked kernel memory, files, sync and event queues, and the host seam and guest memory model.
  - Fibers lock per stripe instead of through one global gate.
  - The thread-local storage lookup `__tls_get_addr` is cached per thread.
  - User-level-thread (ULT) wakeups are targeted to the waiters that changed.
  - Pthread mutexes spin while the owner runs.
  - Short sleeps nap on an escalating schedule.
- **macOS 27:** the OS reserves VA ranges that PS5 titles map. The loader relocates the affected arena bases, including GTA V's RAGE arena and Ghost of Tsushima's batch maps, and maps virtual views into the GPU carveout.
- **Spin-nap patcher:** guest pause/spin loops are patched to sleep. Demon's Souls' idle job workers nap instead of spinning.
- **Display:** the guest render resolution follows the chosen output. There are patches for Unity (boot.config), Unreal, KEX, GTA V, small engines compiled for 3840×2160, and Demon's Souls (its Bluepoint resolution adapter).

## GPU: Metal V2

- **Metal-only renderer** (`SharpEmu.Gpu.Metal`, ~70k lines). There is no Vulkan or MoltenVK layer, and the earlier Metal V1 backend is removed.
- **Command processing** runs on its own thread by default.
  - Program resolution and prefetch run on a separate thread, with pipeline look-ahead across the submissions queued behind it.
  - Encoders are ordered by one fence instead of a barrier after each.
- **Resource materialization** is native and cached. Bindless tables are memoised and kept resident. Repeated lookups skip searches that found nothing last time.
- **Image cache:**
  - Single-copy retile.
  - Write-back of GPU-written images before guest stores.
  - Alias transitions fused, with dead contents discarded.
  - Memoryless stand-ins for colour targets that are only read or stored.
  - Depth/stencil reached on the device instead of through guest memory.
- **Occlusion queries** are counted on the device.
- **Tessellation** uses the hull kernel plus Metal's tessellator, including Ghost of Tsushima's quad-patch instanced grass.
- **Multisampling:** multisampled depth goes through a one-sample proxy plus resolve. A GPU-written HTILE is no longer loaded as a clear (UE5 Nanite).
- **Pipeline cache:**
  - Shaders compile into Metal binary archives, bounded by use and shared across builds.
  - Shader prewarm stores compute pipelines.
  - Guest stores are served while a draw waits for its shader compiles.
- **GPU worker:** no per-draw or per-dispatch allocations, fewer guest re-reads, less lock traffic. Bench tooling is in-tree.

## Shader compiler: gfx10 → MSL

- **Translator** (`SharpEmu.ShaderCompiler.Metal`, ~25k lines) emits Metal Shading Language directly, at gfx10 ISA parity.
- **wave64** runs as two Apple simdgroups. Multi-wave compute groups are bridged across simdgroups and meet at threadgroup barriers. Upper-lane reads and LDS atomics are ordered across the halves.
- **NGG and mesh:** amplified NGG subgroups run as whole mesh workgroups of real wave64 waves.
- **Ray tracing:** BVH nodes are read 16 bytes at a time, with half-precision boxes widened in hardware.
- **Descriptors:** records chosen at run time, branch-chosen V#s, indirect image tables of up to 256 descriptors, and stores through V#s loaded from record tables are all planned and bound.
- **Fixes:** SDWA destination select, `s_cmpk_*`, GDS M0 addressing, FORCE_DEGAMMA samplers, min/max filter samplers, compare samples of mipmapped images, and GLC store write-through.

## Split GPU process

- The GPU backend runs in a separate **native arm64 process**, now the default where it can run.
  - It maps the guest's backing memory and replicates the guest's views.
  - The two processes talk over a shared-memory transport (protocol 2).
- Page-protection tracking is per 4 KiB page. A posted call wakes a single server thread.
- `build-app.sh` bundles the arm64 GPU host in `Contents/MacOS/gpuhost`.

## App

- The launcher is a native arm64 Avalonia app and is the bundle's main executable. Game windows and Dock tiles are named after the game.
- Launcher settings are global, and game settings are per game, with automatic migration. GUI and CLI share one launch configuration.
- All logs, traces and dumps go under one logs folder. Caches are kept outside the signed bundle.
- The performance overlay shows real CPU, GPU busy time and memory for both processes.

## Upstream 0.0.6 → 0.0.7-pulse

- Tessellation, draw reuse and GNM mode.
- XML and pattern game patches, with a patch manager.
- Shader warm-up progress on the splash screen.
- SPIR-V optimisation passes and UE4 ray-tracing shader-call programs.
- Fixes for Saros, Elden Ring, Tomb Raider Legend, NGS2/ATRAC9 and AGC occlusion.
- Simplified Chinese.

## Performance (Apple M4, 1080p, in game)

| Game | FPS |
|---|---|
| Quake, Superliminal, Void Terrarium, Dreaming Sarah | 60 |
| The Oregon Trail | ~58 |
| Poppy Playtime | ~47 |
| GTA V (Performance) | ~46 |
| Silent Hill: The Short Message | ~29 |
| GTA V (Fidelity) | ~7 |
| Demon's Souls | ~3–7 (bound by the game's own CPU work) |

## Known issues

- GTA V Fidelity mode runs at about 7 fps in game. Use Performance mode.
- Demon's Souls is limited by its own job-worker threads. It can also crash intermittently while loading (1 in 3 runs here).

fallbackRelease.bodyNotes:
int21 is int20 plus faster draw validation, fixes for GPU device losses and a silent exit, the latest upstream KytyPS5 changes, ports from chenxiao07's fork and a new profile-guided optimisation profile; the older notes are in docs/release-notes-history.md. The first launch rebuilds the shader and program caches once (the pipeline key changed), so the first minutes can stutter.

- **Faster:** the command processor skips the full validity check of a prepared draw when the GPU has never touched the memory it reads (`KYTY_CLEAN_UNTOUCHED=1`, on in the preset; exact, verified over tens of millions of draws), plus a new profile-guided optimisation profile. Measured with the play folder's three game patches on (non-tiled renderer, GI off, fixed 1080p): pirate island about 58 fps against about 53 in int20, and Sky Garden at its 60 fps pacing cap where int20 ran about 54. Without game patches Sky Garden gained about 1.4% over the last test build.
- **Fixed (device loss):** a small upload's copy from guest memory could run after later writes the command processor or the game made to the same memory, so earlier draws read future data and the GPU could hang. Writes now wait for or take over the queued copies (`KYTY_UPLOAD_DMA_WRITE_DRAIN=1`, on in the preset; `=labels` is a stricter mode for anyone who still sees losses). Also fixed: the texture cache could miss guest writes on pages whose protection was still pending, and draws could keep using a buffer that a later merge had retired (`KYTY_REBIND_AFTER_JOIN=1`).
- **Fixed (silent exit):** on Windows set to force Control Flow Guard on every program, Astro Bot closed without a message (ntdll 0xC0000409) right after shader loading (`KYTY_GUEST_TEB_STACK_RANGE=1`, on in the preset; issue #66).
- **Fixed:** exits on colour targets with an invalid format and on a stencil plane shared with another render target (`KYTY_STENCIL_TARGETS_APART=1`), guest file writes from GPU-protected pages that were silently cut short, and pad presses lost during frame hitches (`KYTY_PAD_STATE_COALESCE=1`).
- **Crash reports:** `KYTY_DEVICE_FAULT_EXT=1` is on in the preset and now writes a complete `_device_fault.nv-gpudmp` file next to `_kyty.txt` when the GPU is lost. Please attach it to device-loss reports.
- **Correction to int20:** int20's notes said the Astro Bot "too many objects/batches" crash was fixed; it was only rarer. The cause was that the game's draw threads overflow their command buffers when they fall a frame behind, mostly on CPUs with fewer cores. int21 doubles those buffers for Astro Bot 01.018 (`KYTY_ASTRO_CB_SCALE=2`) and spreads the game's threads over both CCDs on X3D CPUs (`KYTY_VCACHE_GUEST=all`): 0 crashes in about 20 boots of speedrun_inflator, the level that crashed on every boot before. Players with 8-core CPUs: a report from speedrun_inflator would help.
- **Upstream KytyPS5:** about 150 upstream changes, among them user clip planes, f16 interpolation, alpha-to-mask (`KYTY_ALPHA_TO_MASK`), start on GTX 10xx/RDNA1 cards without fragment-shader barycentrics, a keyboard player option, a performance overlay and fixes for other games behind switches that are off by default. Details are in the commit history.
- **Thanks:** chenxiao07 for the fork changes ported here (colour-target and stencil fixes, the Control Flow Guard fix, pad state, file writes, APR file reads and more), and the upstream KytyPS5 contributors.
- **Known issues:** rare GPU device losses can still happen, seen in sponge_dirty_bath without game patches. Please report them with `_kyty.txt` and `_device_fault.nv-gpudmp`; workaround: `KYTY_UPLOAD_DMA_WRITE_DRAIN=labels` or `KYTY_DEFER_PROTECTS=0` in `u59-preset.json` (about 3% slower).
- **Upgrading:** extract into a new folder, or replace `u59-preset.json` too; an old preset leaves the new fixes off.

fallbackRelease.releaseTitle: KytyPS5 Demon's Souls Frame Generation v1.3
fallbackRelease.bodyNotes:
**What's new in v1.3:** based on the new upstream KytyPS5 **v20261014** by chenxiao07, with all of this build's improvements kept.

- ⭐ **New launcher layout:** the settings are in tabs (Display, Graphics, Performance, System) under the game folder; the window remembers the last tab.
- ⭐ **Shrine of Storms freeze work (known issue #1):** large textures now upload in 64 MB pieces and the partial path no longer re-uploads the whole 1.8 GB pool; this build also turns on upstream's layer-range textures, so the pool's views become small textures of the layers they read (upstream issue #9). Not confirmed at the spot yet: known issue #1 stays open until a session shows it.
- **About 2 GB less RAM** after a save loads, and no more memory growth when travelling between worlds.
- **HDR and VSync options** (Display tab, off by default). With Frame Generation, a G-SYNC display is the better choice than VSync.
- **Fixes from upstream:** a crash when travelling to the Tower of Latria by archstone, a 1.05 crash in Boletaria 1-1, very large textures on 8 GB GPUs, game folders with very long paths.
- **More precompile hints:** shaders from tours of every map, so more first visits are smooth after precompiling.
- **Your shader cache is kept:** upstream now caps the driver shader cache at 1/64 of RAM; this build allows 1/16 (2 GB with 32 GB RAM), so a typical 1.2 GB cache is not thrown away at every launch.

Everything from v1.2 stays: DLSS Frame Generation (**requires an NVIDIA RTX 40 or 50 series card**), render resolution upscaling (the game's own upscaler, not DLSS/FSR), ultrawide for any ultrawide screen, the voices fix.

**Updating from v1.2:** extract the new zip over your old folder (your saves, launcher settings and shader caches stay; the frame generation camera list is replaced by the one in the zip). Your precompiled shaders stay valid; run "Precompile shaders" again if you want the new map-tour shaders too.

**Downloads:** `KytyPS5-DemonsSouls-FrameGen.zip` is the build. `KytyPS5-DemonsSouls-FrameGen-source.zip` is its complete source (KytyPS5 is GPL 2.0; third-party licenses in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

No game files included. Unofficial build, not affiliated with Sony, NVIDIA or the KytyPS5 developers.
